JAINA_KEYWORD_DEATHRATTLE.title: Deathrattle
JAINA_KEYWORD_CHARGE.title: Charge
JAINA_KEYWORD_CHARGE.description: Can attack immediately after being summoned.
JAINA_KEYWORD_FREEZE.title: Freeze
JAINA_KEYWORD_FREEZE.description: Frozen characters deal 12.5% less damage with attacks. Stacks up to 8 times. All stacks are removed at end of turn. Freeze applied by minions is not blocked by Artifacts.
JAINA_KEYWORD_TWINSPELL.title: Twinspell
JAINA_KEYWORD_TWINSPELL.description: When you cast a spell with Twinspell, add a copy of that spell to your hand. The copy does not have Twinspell.
JAINA_KEYWORD_EMPOWER.title: Empower
JAINA_KEYWORD_EMPOWER.description: The first time you Empower, your Hero Power becomes [gold]Blessing of the Imps[/gold]. Each subsequent stack makes your Hero Power cast one extra time.
JAINA_KEYWORD_FINISHER.title: Finisher
JAINA_KEYWORD_FINISHER.description: When you play a card with Finisher, if you use all your Energy, trigger an additional effect.
JAINA_KEYWORD_SPELL.title: Spell
JAINA_KEYWORD_SPELL.description: Attack and Skill cards are both Spell cards.
JAINA_KEYWORD_BATTLECRY.title: Battlecry
JAINA_KEYWORD_BATTLECRY.description: Battlecry: When this card is played from your hand, its effect triggers immediately.
JAINA_KEYWORD_HERO_POWER.title: Hero Power
JAINA_KEYWORD_HERO_POWER.description: Your hero's signature ability (e.g. Fireblast). Returns to hand at the start of each turn.
JAINA_KEYWORD_FIRE.title: Fire
JAINA_KEYWORD_FROST.title: Frost
JAINA_KEYWORD_ARCANE.title: Arcane
JAINA_KEYWORD_SHADOW.title: Shadow
JAINA_KEYWORD_REPLAY.title: Replay 1
JAINA_KEYWORD_REPLAY.description: Replay 1: After this card is played, replay it once (its effect triggers again).
JAINA_KEYWORD_QUEST.title: Quest
JAINA_KEYWORD_QUEST.description: Quest: Complete the quest to receive a reward.
JAINA_KEYWORD_DURABILITY.title: Durability
JAINA_KEYWORD_DURABILITY.description: Durability: When Durability reaches 0, this card is consumed.
JAINA_KEYWORD_WEAPON.title: Weapon
JAINA_KEYWORD_WEAPON.description: Weapon: You can only equip 1 weapon. Equipping a second one destroys the first.
JAINA_KEYWORD_ELEMENTAL.title: Elemental
JAINA_KEYWORD_BEAST.title: Beast
JAINA_KEYWORD_DRAGON.title: Dragon
JAINA_KEYWORD_UNDEAD.title: Undead
JAINA_KEYWORD_DEMON.title: Demon
JAINA_KEYWORD_DRAENEI.title: Draenei
JAINA_KEYWORD_NAGA.title: Naga
JAINA_KEYWORD_PIRATE.title: Pirate
JAINA_KEYWORD_MECH.title: Mech
JAINA_KEYWORD_LIFESTEAL.title: Lifesteal
JAINA_KEYWORD_LIFESTEAL.description: Lifesteal: Heal for the amount of damage dealt.
JAINA_KEYWORD_DISCOVER.title: Discover
JAINA_KEYWORD_DISCOVER.description: Discover: Choose one of three random cards to add to your hand.
JAINA_KEYWORD_IMMUNE.title: Immune
JAINA_KEYWORD_LANDMARK.title: Landmark
JAINA_KEYWORD_LANDMARK.description: Landmark: Occupies a minion slot. Can be clicked to use once every two turns. Has durability; -1 per use, destroyed at 0.
JAINA_KEYWORD_FATIGUE.title: Fatigue
JAINA_KEYWORD_FATIGUE.description: Fatigue: When your Draw Pile and Discard Pile are empty, the 1st card drawn makes you lose 1 HP, the 2nd makes you lose 2 HP, and so on.
JAINA_KEYWORD_MINIATURIZE.title: Miniaturize
JAINA_KEYWORD_MINIATURIZE.description: Miniaturize: After you play a minion with Miniaturize, add a 0-Cost 1/1 copy of it to your hand. Only triggers when played from your hand; Summoning or resurrecting does not trigger it.
JAINA_KEYWORD_MINI.title: Mini
JAINA_KEYWORD_MINI.description: Mini: The 0-Cost 1/1 copy created by Miniaturize (a generated keyword that can only be obtained through Miniaturize). It keeps all text effects of the original card.
JAINA_KEYWORD_TRADEABLE.title: Tradeable
JAINA_KEYWORD_TRADEABLE.description: Tradeable: Left-click this card (right-click to cancel), then click the Discard Pile within 3 seconds to trade it — shuffle this card into your Discard Pile and draw a card.
JAINA_KEYWORD_MINION.title: Minion
JAINA_KEYWORD_MINION.description:
When played, summon a minion with Attack and Health to your [gold]Minion Bar[/gold]. Starting from the turn after it is summoned, you can click it to attack. Unblocked damage you take hits your [gold]minions[/gold] first.
You can have up to 7 [gold]minions[/gold].
JAINA_KEYWORD_SPECIAL_HERO_SKILL.title: Empowered Skill
JAINA_KEYWORD_SPECIAL_HERO_SKILL.descrip: Blessing of the Imps: summon 1 Imp and deal 1 damage randomly split among all enemies. Casts once per Empower stack.
JAINA_KEYWORD_IGNITE.title: Ignite
JAINA_KEYWORD_IGNITE.description: Ignite: A card with Ignite is Exhausted after 3 turns. Example: if a card is Ignited on turn 1, it is Exhausted at the end of turn 3 if it is still in your hand.
